use purg_auth::{cert::Cert, hex, keys, modsig, proof, record, server, session};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::fs;

fn w(dir: &str, name: &str, data: &[u8]) {
    fs::write(format!("{dir}/{name}"), data).unwrap();
}

fn main() {
    let dir = std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap();
    let user = [1u8; 32];
    let signer = [2u8; 32];
    let counter = [3u8; 32];
    w(&dir, "user.seed", &user);
    w(&dir, "signer.seed", &signer);
    w(&dir, "user.pub", &purg_auth::public_key(&user));
    let mut c = Cert::new("alice", purg_auth::public_key(&user), 1_800_000_000).unwrap();
    c.sign(&signer).unwrap();
    w(&dir, "cert1.txt", c.encode().as_bytes());
    let mut cc = c.clone();
    cc.sign(&counter).unwrap();
    w(&dir, "cert2.txt", cc.encode().as_bytes());
    let info = keys::AuthInfo { seed: user, signer: purg_auth::public_key(&signer), cert: c.clone() };
    w(&dir, "authinfo", info.encode().as_bytes());
    let mut list = String::from("# signers\n");
    list.push_str(&keys::list_line(&purg_auth::public_key(&signer), "mysigner"));
    w(&dir, "signers", list.as_bytes());
    // v2 proof
    let chal = [7u8; 32];
    let p2 = proof::make(&user, Some(&c), &chal, "alice", "");
    w(&dir, "proof2.bin", &p2);
    let p2k = proof::make(&user, None, &chal, "alice", "x");
    w(&dir, "proof2k.bin", &p2k);
    // v3
    let srv = session::Server::new(chal, [8u8; 32]);
    w(&dir, "offer3.bin", &srv.offer);
    let cl = session::Client::new(&srv.offer, [9u8; 32]).unwrap();
    w(&dir, "signed3.bin", &cl.signed);
    let p3 = proof::make(&user, Some(&c), &cl.signed, "alice", "aname");
    w(&dir, "proof3.bin", &p3);
    let k = cl.keys("alice", "aname", &p3).unwrap();
    let ks = srv.keys("alice", "aname", &p3).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(k, ks);
    let mut kb = Vec::new();
    kb.extend_from_slice(&k.c2s); kb.extend_from_slice(&k.s2c); kb.extend_from_slice(&k.transcript); kb.extend_from_slice(&k.bind);
    w(&dir, "keys3.bin", &kb);
    let (mut sealer, _) = k.client();
    let mut recs = Vec::new();
    for m in [&b"hello"[..], b"", &[0xabu8; 300][..]] {
        recs.extend_from_slice(&sealer.seal(m).unwrap());
    }
    w(&dir, "records.bin", &recs);
    let sp = server::make(&signer, None, &k);
    w(&dir, "srvproof.bin", &sp);
    let sp2 = server::make(&user, Some(&c), &k);
    w(&dir, "srvproof2.bin", &sp2);
    // module
    let mut wasm = b"\0asm\x01\0\0\0".to_vec();
    // custom purgatorio.abi "0.9"
    let name = b"purgatorio.abi";
    let mut body = vec![name.len() as u8];
    body.extend_from_slice(name);
    body.extend_from_slice(b"0.9");
    wasm.push(0); wasm.push(body.len() as u8); wasm.extend_from_slice(&body);
    // type section: one func type () -> ()
    wasm.extend_from_slice(&[1, 4, 1, 0x60, 0, 0]);
    w(&dir, "module.wasm", &wasm);
    w(&dir, "module.digest", &modsig::digest(&wasm).unwrap());
    let signed = modsig::sign(&wasm, &signer, vec![]).unwrap();
    w(&dir, "module.key.wasm", &signed);
    // cert chain: user key certified by signer
    let signed2 = modsig::sign(&signed, &user, vec![c.clone()]).unwrap();
    w(&dir, "module.chain.wasm", &signed2);
    // image
    let digest = modsig::digest(&wasm).unwrap();
    let image = b"not really machine code";
    let idig: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(image).into();
    let mut msg = b"pgaotimg1\0".to_vec();
    msg.push(0); msg.extend_from_slice(&digest); msg.extend_from_slice(&idig);
    let entry = modsig::Entry::new(purg_auth::public_key(&signer), purg_auth::sign(&signer, &msg), vec![]).unwrap();
    let mut out = b"PURGIMG1".to_vec();
    out.extend_from_slice(&[0, 0, 0, 0]);
    out.extend_from_slice(&digest);
    out.extend_from_slice(&(image.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(image);
    out.extend_from_slice(&modsig::encode(&[entry]));
    w(&dir, "image.cwasm", &out);
    println!("{}", hex::encode(&k.c2s));
}
